profile.description: Ligand Pharmaceuticals is an American biopharmaceutical company that focuses on acquiring and developing royalty-generating assets. As of 2024, the company's portfolio included royalty rights to approximately 90 pharmaceutical products across a range of therapeutic areas.
profile.description_zh: Ligand Pharmaceuticals 是一家美国生物制药公司，专注于收购和开发产生特许权使用费的资产。截至2024年，公司投资组合涵盖约90种跨治疗领域的药品特许权。
